newsitem.title: USA: HFS names Robert Moles as Century 21 president.
newsitem.headline: HFS names Robert Moles as Century 21 president.

text.p: HFS Inc said Monday it had named Robert Moles as president of Century 21 Real Estate Corp.
Moles, who was president and chief executive officer of Contempo Realty, will take on his new job on March 10, it said.
HFS also said the 18 offices of Contempo Realty with 850 agents will join the Century 21 broker network.

National Realty Trust, one of HFS's largest real estate franchises, has agreed to buy the Contempo Realty offices, which handled more than $2.4 billion in transaction volume in 1996, it said, adding that National Realty with operate them for Century 21.
HFS Inc franchises hotels and residential real estate brokerage offices, among other things.
